neighbours.label: the comma or 'and' that opens a second, parallel item right after an object noun ('cause DNA, or other molecules, to …'; 'kept the city solvent and its …')
fire: Strong acid can cause RNA, or other polymers, to break apart.
Radiation may damage DNA, or other large molecules, inside the cell.
Her careful budgeting kept the school open and its library well stocked.
High pressure can force proteins, or other chains, to fold differently.
The new mayor kept the town calm and its debts low.
Sunlight can cause plastics, or other compounds, to turn brittle.
The treaty left the port neutral and its trade untaxed.
Cold can make steel, or other alloys, crack under load.
quiet: Strong acid can break RNA apart within a few minutes.
Radiation may damage the large molecules inside the cell.
Her careful budgeting kept the school library open all year.
High pressure can force proteins to fold differently.
The new mayor calmed the town within a month.
Sunlight can turn plastics brittle within a few years.
The treaty declared the port neutral for ten years.
Cold can make steel crack under load.

notes: Card: ' of', ' the', ',', ' and', ' all' and Arabic pieces; no clear pattern.
